releases.name: Sprigatito & Lucario ex Starter Set ex

description.text: Starter Set ex Sprigatito & Lucario ex, one of three starter sets released on 20 January 2023, the day the Scarlet & Violet series began with the Scarlet ex and Violet ex expansions. Its deck pairs Sprigatito and its evolutions with Lucario ex, which evolves from Riolu and whose stronger attack also does 50 damage to a Benched Pokémon. Each box held a ready-to-play 60-card deck with one Pokémon ex, damage counters and markers, a coin, a playmat, a rule book and a guide, and a promo pack with one card drawn at random from four: two suited to its deck and two that suit any of them, Cyclizar ex among them.
